name.value: Bharti AXA Life Cover Plus Linked Term Rider
name.quote: Bharti AXA Life Cover Plus Linked Term Rider

linked_or_non_linked.value: non-linked, non-participating individual life insurance rider; separate rider premium
linked_or_non_linked.quote: A Non-Linked, Non- Participating Individual Life Insurance Rider
linked_or_non_linked.note: Name says "Linked" because it attaches to linked base policies.

attached_to_ulips.note: Named in these four ULIP brochures (see results/ulip_rider_map.csv).

waiver_of_premium.note: The rider pays a death benefit only. It has no waiver, critical illness, accident, disability or hospital cash benefit.

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.note: The rider pays a death benefit only. It has no waiver, critical illness, accident, disability or hospital cash benefit.

critical_illness.note: The rider pays a death benefit only. It has no waiver, critical illness, accident, disability or hospital cash benefit.

accidental_death.value: Death from any cause is covered by the term cover. There is no separate accidental death option.
accidental_death.quote: In the event of death of Life Insured, the Sum Assured under the Rider will be paid to the Policyholder/nominee in addition to the Sum Assured under the base policy

accidental_disability.note: The rider pays a death benefit only. It has no waiver, critical illness, accident, disability or hospital cash benefit.

term_cover.value: Rider sum assured is paid on death of the life assured, in addition to the base policy sum assured. The rider then ends. There is no maturity value.
term_cover.quote: In the event of death of Life Insured, the Sum Assured under the Rider will be paid to the Policyholder/nominee in addition to the Sum Assured under the base policy

hospital_cash.note: The rider pays a death benefit only. It has no waiver, critical illness, accident, disability or hospital cash benefit.

other.value: Surrender value is an unexpired risk premium at 70% (single pay, immediately; limited pay, after two full years of premium).
other.quote: The Unexpired Risk Premium Factor (URPF) of 70%

premium_paying_rules.value: Single pay (1 year), limited pay (5, 6, 7, 10, 12 or 15 years) or regular pay (10 to 40 years, equal to the term). Modes: single, annual, semi-annual, quarterly and monthly (quarterly and monthly through auto pay only).
premium_paying_rules.quote: Single, Annual, semi- annual, quarterly* & monthly*

entry_age.value: 18 to 60 years; maximum age at maturity 100

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 25,000. No maximum, subject to the company's board-approved underwriting policy.

premium_deduction.value: Separate rider premium. The ULIP brochure says the rider is availed by "paying additional premium". The rider documents do not mention deduction from the fund.
premium_deduction.quote: the following rider can be availed by paying additional premium along with Bharti AXA Life
